verdict.rationale: Sentry documents ingesting OpenTelemetry traces and logs via OTLP. It also offers a Trace Explorer for querying span data and dashboards that navigate error and performance data across projects, so traces, logs and errors do land in one platform. Metrics as a telemetry type are not evidenced, and nothing documents pivoting between signals with shared context such as trace-to-log correlation. missing for 10: explicit metrics ingestion/support, documented cross-signal pivoting with shared context (trace↔log↔metric linking), independent or hands-on corroboration of unified telemetry workflows.
